statement: SDL Triton sends 64-byte feature report1 with bytes [0x01,0x87,0x03,0x09,0x00,0x00] and remaining zeros to disable lizard mode; it writes this on the active UpdateDevice path and refreshes by its own 3000ms software interval, with no SET response payload consumed. This does not demonstrate a physical watchdog period. SDL steam_triton.c:127-139,485-506; SDL structures:25-33,38-54.
